title: Data guards — DLP for agents
summary: You just emailed the customer table. Allow-listing a domain is not DLP. Classify the data and block or mask it on four channels: prompt, RAG, model output, and tool results.
takeaway: DLP inspects the payload. Destination allow-lists inspect the envelope. Agents need both, on every hop data moves.
design_rule: Restricted → block; confidential → mask. Apply on input, context, output, and tool results — not only the chat transcript.
